model.replacesChat: A local model loaded here takes the place of the chat's in memory. The chat keeps its own model and loads it again for its next question.
model.freeTitle: Unload the idle engines (Whisper, voice, embedder…)
host.tooOld: This version of Mnemosyne does not have this feature yet. Update the app.
translate.placeholder: Type or paste a text. Ctrl+Enter translates.
translate.onlyText: Here: .md or .txt. PDF and DOCX go in Documents.
translate.readFailed: The file could not be read
translate.echo: The model handed the text back without translating it. Try again, or pick another model.
translate.stopped: Stopped: what was translated so far is kept.
translate.sameLanguage: The text is already in {{lang}}. Pick another target.
chat.sent: In the chat, ready to discuss
chat.needsClick: The chat takes it only from a click in this window. Click the button again.
chat.draftTranslation: Here is a translation. Is it faithful? Point out what could be said better.
chat.draftDocument: Here is the translation of {{name}}. Summarize it and tell me what matters.
chat.draftWeb: Here is a web page I translated. Summarize it, and tell me what is worth remembering.
chat.draftBench: Here is a comparison of translation engines on the same text. Which one translates best, and why?
docs.alreadyQueued: That file is already in the list
docs.needsPermission: Opening files needs the "dialog:open" permission: restart the app, then accept it.
docs.truncated: The document was cut when it was read: the end is missing.
web.emptyHint: Read on this computer, translated, then a report for the chat.
web.keepTitle: In the Translator's vault ({{vault}}). You make it permanent from the vault manager.
web.noVault: The Translator's vault is not ready
web.err.https: Only https:// pages can be read.
web.err.notText: That address is not a text page (an image, a PDF, a file…).
web.err.empty: The page has no readable text.
web.err.http: The site answered with an error ({{code}}).
web.err.generic: The page could not be read: {{error}}
report.truncated: The page was cut when it was read: the end is missing.
bench.name: Scenario name
bench.textPlaceholder: The text every engine will translate
bench.noEngine: Add at least one engine, two to compare.
bench.freeBefore: Free memory before each local model
bench.unloadAfter: Unload each local model after its turn
bench.sequentialNote: One engine at a time: load, translate, unload, next. The chat shares the memory: leave it idle during a run.
bench.agreementHint: Shared words between two translations. Agreement, not quality: two engines can agree on a mistake.
bench.diffTooLong: Too long to compare word by word.
vocab.noneFound: No word worth learning in this translation
vocab.emptyHint: Translate, then press Words to collect what is worth learning.
review.title: Review
settings.title: Settings
settings.freeBeforeLoad: Free memory before loading a local model
beta.title: Beta: an extra model pass
chat.sentCut: In the chat, cut to its first 120 000 characters
model.ritualBusy: A model is already loading: finish that dialog first.
model.needsClick: Click the model again: loading needs a click in this window.
bench.blocking: A comparison is running: translating waits until it ends.
model.loadedNoRitual: Loaded without the memory check: the Translator is in its own window. Open it on the board to get the loading dialog.
chat.notOnBoard: No chat to hand it to: the Translator is in its own window. Open it on the board, then try again.
web.keptCut: Kept in {{vault}}, cut to its first {{max}} characters
bench.waitOthers: A translation is running in another tab: the comparison waits until it ends.
